metadata.description: Open Agent AI Security's Claude Code plugin marketplace — legacy mirror carrying praxen only. The canonical index is https://github.com/open-agent-ai-security/plugins; this in-repo copy serves existing installs added from open-agent-ai-security/praxen and is kept in sync by CI. Other community plugins install from the canonical index.

plugins.name: praxen
plugins.description: Praxen — agent behavior verifier. Compares an agent's declared policy against the available evidence (source, deployment state, or behavioral artifacts); reports where observed behavior diverges from declared intent.
